latest.title: Deformations of Kähler and Balanced Hyperbolicity
latest.abstract: We study the deformation stability of Kähler and balanced hyperbolicity. Balanced hyperbolicity is not open in general: in every complex dimension $N\geq5$ we construct a one-parameter family with balanced hyperbolic central fibre and non-balanced nearby fibres. For positive results, we develop three complementary mechanisms. A finite-dimensional moving-intersection framework tracks $\widetilde d$-bounded de Rham classes through moving pure-type loci; its Aeppli and Dolbeault realizations yield continuation, transversality, and positivity criteria for balanced and Kähler hyperbolicity. A topological mechanism combines the graded-ideal property of hyperbolic cohomology with the hard Lefschetz theorem to obtain saturation and higher-power propagation results. Finally, on the universal cover, we reduce the passage from a bounded $(\partial+\bar\partial)$-potential to a bounded $d$-primitive to a single bounded top-row $\partial$-equation, and package the dependence on the potential into a canonical quotient obstruction. Together, these viewpoints yield a range of deformation stability results.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 构造复维至少五时 balanced 双曲性不开放的一参数形变族，同时建立 Kähler 与 balanced 双曲性的若干稳定性准则。
techniques: 万有覆叠有界原始形式
latest.breakthrough: 用反例划定稳定性边界，并把有界势到有界原始形式的提升障碍压缩为一个有界 ∂ 方程及商空间障碍。
latest.limitations: 反例的邻近纤维甚至不再 balanced；在邻近纤维保持 balanced 的附加条件下，双曲性是否持续仍被列为开放问题。正面结论需要上同调、秩或横截条件。
latest.aiEvidence: 反例由 gpt-5.6-sol 辅助构造，作者随后仔细核验其数学正确性。
latest.priorityReason: 反例与稳定机制互补，连接覆叠空间分析和复几何形变。
